convention: Furlong+15 factors, as used by the SWIFT/VELOCIraptor comparison-data compilation
note: One set of stellar-mass offsets for converting an IMF to Chabrier 2003. Population averages: the true offset depends on a galaxy's age and on the mass range of the IMF, so any such conversion is uncertain at about the 0.02 dex level. The set is a convention chosen so that the Explorer's optional conversion agrees with the conversion the compilation already applied to nine observation curves (data/analysis/conversions-audit.json).

origin.factors: scripts/cosmology.py of https://github.com/calvin-sykes/velociraptor-comparison-data at commit fc740f4 ('IMF conversion factors from Furlong+ 2015': kroupa_to_chabrier_mass = 0.912, salpeter_to_chabrier_mass = 0.606)
origin.furlong15: Furlong et al. 2015 (arXiv:1410.3485), Sec. 2: star formation amplitude lowered by a factor 1.65 (= 1/0.606) for a Chabrier instead of a Salpeter IMF; the Kroupa factor is not stated there.

previousWebsiteSet.reason: Its origin was not documented and it differed from the conversion the compilation applied by 0.015 dex (Kroupa) and 0.017 dex (Salpeter).

frozenForRegisteredStudies.note: A registered analysis keeps the offsets it was registered with. scripts/analyze_harmonization.py can re-run with the current set (HARM_IMF_SET=current) as an exploratory sensitivity check: data/analysis/harmonization-imf-sensitivity.json.
